Name: Simple Lasting Soil
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Simple Lasting Soil[/b]
Spend less time re-tilling empty farmland!
Reduces the daily chance of empty tilled soil disappearing from [b]10% to 2%[/b] by default a [b]98% chance of staying tilled overnight[/b].
[list]
[*]Supports your farm, Ginger Island and modded farm locations.[/*]
[*]Adjustable through optional Generic Mod Config Menu or
[code]config.json[/code].[/*]
[*]Includes all 12 game languages.[/*]
[/list]Does not keep soil watered or change crop growth. Season-change cleanup remains unchanged.
[b]Requires:[/b] SMAPI. GMCM is optional.
[b]Installation:[/b] Extract into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder. In multiplayer, install on the host.

Manifest.Name: Simple Lasting Soil
Manifest.Description: Reduces daily decay of empty tilled farm soil, with optional darker watered soil.
Manifest.Author: Xsyy
